snippet.title: Hyrule Warriors: Legends - Limited Edition Trailer (Nintendo 3DS)
snippet.description:
Hyrule Warriors: Legends lands on Nintendo 3DS on 25th March 2016. This Limited Edition will also arrive on the same day.

Official Website:  https://www.nintendo.co.uk
